_comment: Exceptions to deploy/compose_policy.py, per project repo (folder name). Every deployed project repo must be listed. names: service, container and alias names allowed on shared networks. images: names a repo may give images it builds. networks/volumes: fixed (unprefixed) names the repo may create. cap_add: capabilities it may add. binds: folders (relative to the repo root) it may bind-mount. allow_net_raw / allow_no_limits: temporary exemptions from requiring cap_drop NET_RAW on shared networks and cpus/mem_limit/pids_limit.
